title: Shadows of Crazy
description: Shadows of Crazy is heavily inspired by the old Crazy Craft packs, and has something for every play style!!!
body:
![Shadows of Crazy logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3d7c2df751a7f2de1b5eb617c95ad842c70a1082.png)
 
Shadows of Crazy is a modpack heavily inspired by the old Crazy Craft packs. It has several of the old mods that were in those packs like  The Twilight Forest, Tinkers' Constructs, and Inventory Pets, and remakes of old mods that don't exist anymore such as Craziness Awakened (the Orespawn remake). There are also some new mods thrown in that I feel fit the pack and make up for some of the mods that aren't available or haven't been updated to the newer versions of Minecraft.

_There are some mods that could not be added to the pack as the developers don't want their creations distributed by third parties. So these are links to the versions of the mods that I recommend adding._

  - Twilight Forest: https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/the-twilight-forest/files/5468648
  - Killer Pacman Reborn: https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/killer-pacman-reborn/files/6539361
  - Mob Grinding Utils: https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/mob-grinding-utils/files/5131447
  - Tinker In Caves: https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/tinker-in-caves/files/6514872

This pack was mainly put together for the entertainment of myself and my friends. I would still appreciate any feedback you may have for future versions or if any mods in the pack don't work. I spent around 12 hours testing the pack, which allowed me to find some critical flaws/failures that have been removed, but I can't 100% guarantee that there is nothing broken.

The group that all played on the server that this pack was made for have their own YouTube channels. We would all appreciate if you checked the channels out with the links below!
